subject: Fix warnings and formatting (#503)
reason: The change is a warnings-and-formatting cleanup with no behaviour change. The only production-code edit adds `default: CHECK(false)` to the KeyAccessToStringView switch in src/acl.cc, which is unreachable: acl::KeyAccess has exactly two enumerators (kRead, kWrite) and every call site passes one of them as a literal, so the default exists only to silence the compiler's missing-return warning. The remaining edits are pointer-formatting in vmsdk/src/testing_infra/utils.cc and gmock Invoke() shorthand in vmsdk/testing/cluster_map_test.cc, both test-infrastructure files not compiled into the shippe
